entries.title: Zechariah 13:1
segments: ¶In that day there shall be a fountain opened to the house of David and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem for sin and for uncleanness. {uncleanness: Heb. separation for uncleanness}

entries.title: Zechariah 13:2
segments: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the LORD of hosts, [that] I will cut off the names of the idols out of the land, and they shall no more be remembered: and also I will cause the prophets and the unclean spirit to pass out of the land.

words.text: And it shall come to pass in that day
, and they shall no more be remembered
: and also I will cause the prophets

entries.title: Zechariah 13:3
segments: And it shall come to pass, [that] when any shall yet prophesy, then his father and his mother that begat him shall say unto him, Thou shalt not live; for thou speakest lies in the name of the LORD: and his father and his mother that begat him shall thrust him through when he prophesieth.

words.text: And it shall come to pass, [that] when any
unto him, Thou shalt not live

entries.title: Zechariah 13:4
segments: And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] the prophets shall be ashamed every one of his vision, when he hath prophesied; neither shall they wear a rough garment to deceive: {a rough...: Heb. a garment of hair} {deceive: Heb. lie}

words.text: And it shall come to pass in that day
: {a rough...: Heb. a garment of hair} {deceive: Heb. lie}

entries.title: Zechariah 13:5
segments: But he shall say, I [am] no prophet, I [am] an husbandman; for man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.

entries.title: Zechariah 13:6
segments: And [one] shall say unto him, What [are] these wounds in thine hands? Then he shall answer, [Those] with which I was wounded [in] the house of my friends.

entries.title: Zechariah 13:7
segments: ¶Awake, O sword, against my shepherd, and against the man [that is] my fellow, saith the LORD of hosts: smite the shepherd, and the sheep shall be scattered: and I will turn mine hand upon the little ones.

entries.title: Zechariah 13:8
segments: And it shall come to pass, [that] in all the land, saith the LORD, two parts therein shall be cut off [and] die; but the third shall be left therein.

words.text: And it shall come to pass, [that] in all the land

entries.title: Zechariah 13:9
segments: And I will bring the third part through the fire, and will refine them as silver is refined, and will try them as gold is tried: they shall call on my name, and I will hear them: I will say, It [is] my people: and they shall say, The LORD [is] my God.
